chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-04.proposition: Faith-based organizations provide extensive health care, relief, and support to vulnerable people, demonstrating concrete human benefits inspired by religion.

orphanFallback.rationale: The cited scale of faith-based health care, HIV/AIDS care, relief, and local support independently establishes a material welfare contribution even without an earlier opposing move.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-06.proposition: Removing religion would not eliminate fanaticism, while authentic faith produces moral, spiritual, and emotional benefits whose absence would diminish human life.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move supplies its own comparative baseline: fanaticism also arises outside religion, whereas authentic faith contributes stated human goods, supporting a freestanding on-balance case.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-09.proposition: Wrongdoing is neither universal among believers nor unique to religion, while faith also motivates valuable service that should count in an overall assessment.

orphanFallback.rationale: Its contrast between nonreligious wrongdoing and faith-motivated good independently establishes an even-handed causal and balancing standard for assessing religion as a whole.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-01.proposition: Religious faith genuinely motivates compassionate service, interfaith cooperation, and substantial organized aid rather than merely attaching supernatural promises to humane conduct.

orphanFallback.rationale: The supplied examples of organized aid, health work, abolitionism, and believers identifying faith as their motive form an independent causal case for religiously inspired service.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-03.proposition: Religion can help overcome communal conflict when its cross-traditional ethic of compassion, inclusion, and service directs believers to bridge divisions.

orphanFallback.rationale: The Northern Ireland and sub-Saharan examples, joined to a compassion-centered account of faith, independently identify a religious mechanism for reconciliation across communal divisions.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-08.proposition: Pluralist democracy can permit believers to participate publicly while requiring them to respect collective democratic authority and the equal freedom of others.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move states a self-contained institutional model in which religious participation is bounded by democratic will and equal liberty, making its pluralist claim independent of any prior objection.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-002.proposition: Cooperation among Jewish, Muslim, and Christian leaders and communities can help resolve sacred disputes by fostering peace, tolerance, and shared access to holy places.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source directly presents interfaith cooperation, supported by political will, as a mechanism for resolving conflict and negotiating shared access, so it already stands constructively.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-004.proposition: Harmful scriptural literalism can be constrained through historically informed interpretation centered on love, sacrifice, and service to others.

orphanFallback.rationale: Blair's call to interpret doctrine so that it reflects service through love supplies a freestanding method by which religious traditions can recognize and correct harmful readings.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-006.proposition: Belief in a higher power can foster humility and binding moral obligation, giving many believers a distinctive impulse toward forgiveness, peace, and self-improvement.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source independently connects obedience to a higher will with obligation, forgiveness, peace, and becoming better, providing a positive mechanism for faith-shaped moral agency.

chunk-004:chunk004-candidate-001.proposition: Communism demonstrates that suppression of freedom and fanatical demands for conformity are not confined to religious faith.

orphanFallback.rationale: The secular example independently supports the narrower proposition that authoritarian repression and fanaticism occur in multiple domains and therefore are not unique consequences of religious authority.

chunk-004:chunk004-candidate-003.proposition: Faith can rationally address meaning and purpose beyond scientific explanations of life's processes while directing human will toward better conduct.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction between scientific explanation of processes and faith's account of purpose independently grounds a positive claim that higher purpose can guide people toward better lives.
